**BLUF:** In Tazewell County and immediate surroundings, the Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office warned residents about phone scams impersonating court or law enforcement officials seeking money or information.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/) McDowell County (WV) announced a toy drive and will host Mountaineer Food Bank giveaways this week. Bluefield State University named an interim president. Funds were approved for a wind turbine energy recovery project in Southwest Virginia.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/) No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core area today. Regionally, a Kanawha County (WV) man remains missing since September, with authorities seeking public help.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core**  
Tazewell County, VA: The Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office issued a public warning about ongoing scams in which callers impersonate court officials, pretrial services, or law enforcement to solicit money or credit card details from families of inmates. Officials emphasized that legitimate court or pretrial staff will not request funds by phone.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  

McDowell County, WV: The McDowell County Sheriff’s Office announced a toy drive.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  

**Region**  
Kanawha County, WV: Authorities continue to seek public assistance locating a man missing since September.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for core agencies (Tazewell County Sheriff, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA or WV police, Mercer County Sheriff, or state police divisions).

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core**  
Tazewell County / North Tazewell area (ZIP 24651): No active NWS alerts. Forecast for Monday, Oct. 26: sunny, highs in the mid-60s, lows around 40–47°F. No road closures or power/water issues noted.[[2]](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/10-day-weather/north-tazewell-va-24651)  

**Region**  
Nothing significant reported on I-77, I-81, I-64, or other major routes in the 200-mile radius.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core**  
Bluefield, WV (Mercer County): Bluefield State University Board of Governors named an interim president.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  

Tazewell County, VA: Recent actions include a new policy requiring nonprofits seeking county funds to certify they have no registered sex offenders on their boards, and ongoing implementation of the merged Tazewell County Volunteer Fire Co. (operational since mid-October) funded partly by a meals tax.[[3]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)[[4]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/new-tazewell-county-policy-for-nonprofits-addresses-public-concern-over-sex-offenders/)  

**Region**  
Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours from Richmond, Charleston, or other state capitals affecting the area.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core**  
Southwest Virginia: Funds approved for a wind turbine energy recovery project.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  

McDowell County, WV / surrounding: Mountaineer Food Bank hosting food giveaways in McDowell County (and Fayette/Greenbrier) on Oct. 27–28.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  

**Region**  
Nothing additional on major employers, mines, hospitals, or energy projects in the last 24 hours.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Oct. 27–28: Mountaineer Food Bank giveaways in McDowell County and nearby WV counties.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)  
- Oct. 27: Tazewell County Public Library (Pocahontas) Halloween event.  
- Oct. 29: Meet the Candidates event in Tazewell; various Halloween trunk-or-treat events across Tazewell County towns.  
- Ongoing: Tazewell County Volunteer Fire Co. operations and recruitment; Bluefield State University leadership transition.  
- Weather: Continued mild and mostly sunny through mid-week.
